description: Rung 3 of DETERMINEX_LIVE_REACT_UNIFIED_PRODUCT_SHELL_SERIES. Live React IdeaLabPanel mounted at frontend/src/components/ide-product-shell/IdeaLabPanel.tsx. Renders 10 required sections: idea_intake_status, support_check_status, blueprint_status, scaffold_status, tests_status, build_test_verifier_status, smoke_status, evidence_status, training_eligibility_status, unsupported_caveat_status. 'Build It' button is disabled until supportCheckPassed; 'Working' badge is gated on (buildVerifierPassed && testsPassed && smokePassed). Generated-but-unverified state is visibly rendered as 'GENERATED_UNVERIFIED'. Cost/setup caveats including 'not all apps' and 'not all languages' visible. training_eligibility status always reads 'training_eligible: false (remains false)'. Tests forbid mutating Tauri verbs and forbidden success text.
